recipes.name: CoEvo · observed pilot v2
setup: Install from pinned CoEvo/ package root with its declared evotoolkit dependency; prepare tokenizer cache.
Use the separately versioned observed-v2 driver; prior coevo recipe and sealed run receipts stay unchanged.

profiles.description: Native CoEvo CPU pilot with byte-preserving, sequenced sidecars around native generation-history saves.

evaluation.description: Native CoEvoMethod.run searches its multi-representation solution chains and invokes Oscillation1Task evaluation.

argument_help: Configure API_URL, API_KEY and MODEL as explicit environment variables; avoid model_config.json secrets.
limitations: Requires pinned CoEvo package and external evotoolkit dependency; native train.csv is used unchanged.
Native summarizer loads the openai-community/gpt2 tokenizer; cache/data setup must be prepared.
The evidence-hashed placeholder model_config.json is removed only from the isolated workspace before launch, so the unchanged native program uses explicit API_URL/API_KEY/MODEL environment variables.
Native evotoolkit uses verified HTTPS via the loopback TLS relay. The reviewed GPT-2 tokenizer and model weights must be cached and hash-verified offline.
The task timeout_seconds value is not enforced by native Oscillation1Task; only the outer process/cgroup wall limit stops a hung candidate. Native evaluations are sequential.
The native generation-zero overwrite and duplicate representative registration remain unchanged in the optimizer. Distinct native saves are captured with monotonic sidecar sequence IDs.
History rows and distinct registered records do not establish physical evaluation or model-request counts. Sidecars verify the pinned CoEvo persistence source and evotoolkit 1.0.2 file hashes.
Sidecar limits: 100 native saves, 8 MiB per snapshot, 128 MiB total. No checkpoints or pickle data are read.
